name: example-agency-docs-hub
title: docs-hub page kind
description: A static developer documentation hub or knowledge base page kind: header with a labelled search field, hero, quick-start steps, a guides grid, optional API/reference entry points, one static code sample, an optional changelog and optional community/support links, and a footer. Fits product docs sites, developer portals and help centers. Composed from ten vendored HyperUI blocks with Tailwind compiled once and inlined; no page kind JavaScript.

query.en: Use the docs-hub family for a static developer documentation hub or knowledge base mock: header with product name and search, hero, quick-start steps, a guides grid, optional API/reference entry points, one static code sample, an optional changelog and optional community/support links, and a footer. Ask for the product name, what the docs cover and who reads them, generate a schemaVersion 2 docs-hub typed recipe through the bundled trusted compiler, and render it. This is a page kind, not a decoded client site: every business fact in the reference fixture is a placeholder, and the search field and code sample are static, non-functional mocks.
